run_lm_finetuning: run BERT pre-training on a text corpus with masked language modeling and next sentence prediction
create_BERTDataset: create a BERTDataset that loads text corpus samples as paired sentences for language model training
convert_example_to_features: convert an InputExample with tokenized sentences into BERT input features including masked labels
random_word: apply BERT-style random word masking with 80% mask, 10% random, 10% keep strategy to a token list
truncate_seq_pair: truncate a pair of token sequences in place so their combined length fits within a maximum length
